# Mnemo Memory List / Select

This workflow was merged into `/mnemo.memory-pack-export`.

use `/mnemo.memory-pack-export` with no argument to browse exportable topics/groups and continue directly into preview, redaction preview, approval, and export.

use `/mnemo.memory-pack-export <topic-or-group>` to resolve a topic/group directly and continue into export.

Do not perform any tool calls from this stub.
